purpose: approved in-use toolchain/dependency freeze and per-component licensing scope; original ReverieVR software MIT (owner selected)

limitations: ubuntu-latest and the three workflow action v4 selectors are still mutable: tracked as risks because existing GitHub Actions have not been modified without explicit authorization.
JDK 17 selects a major version rather than an exact patch; Android commandline-tools latest and upstream runner images are not byte-locked.
The pinned toolchain below describes accepted versions/configuration; provenance of exact transitive downloaded Maven binaries must be generated from a trusted resolved build.

dosbox_pure.classification: native DOS runtime (required for full phone-test build)

gradle_coordinates.resolution: direct coordinates pinned; transitive Gradle lockfiles and repository verification-metadata.xml not yet generated/reviewed. Do not claim full transitive reproducibility.

offline_asset_construction.classification: asset import and optimization tooling; not packaged or executed in Android runtime

steam_controller_archive.license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (upstream Valve CAD derivative, subject to validation)
steam_controller_archive.redistribution: restricted CC BY-NC-SA, historic public commits/older APKs must be audited; user-local future import not yet supported
steam_controller_archive.classification: historical Git blob and licensed optional art; removed from default APK source tree

daydream_controller_obj.license: CC-BY (source states attribution; version not established by local notice), upstream derivative repository GPL-3.0
daydream_controller_obj.redistribution: preserve model attribution and source GPL notice; legal compatibility review required

doom_shareware.redistribution: original shareware archive only, free/noncommercial releases currently bundle when fetched; independent optionalization still planned

licensing.reverievr_original_code: MIT; limited to independently authored project software, not third-party work, source archives, assets with unverified provenance, or a blanket APK license
licensing.not_a_grant: Third-party license records retain their original scopes. The MIT grant covers owner-authored ReverieVR software; neither the root MIT text nor the release manifest sublicenses third-party assets or resolves the GPL linked-work question.

records.license: Apache-2.0; runtime deps Apache-2.0/MIT/Bouncy Castle permissive
CC attribution upstream plus GPL-3.0 derivative repository notice

licensing.commercial_distribution: HOLD: Valve derivative is removed from current main tree, but earlier public history/releases, Daydream model and current DOOM shareware packaging must be reviewed, plus GPL corresponding source.
licensing.third_party_source_release: Whenever GPL components ship, publish required notices and complete corresponding source/build information for the exact shipped versions.
licensing.reverievr_original_art_default: CC-BY-4.0 for confirmed owner-created creative works only; CC0-1.0 by explicit per-file dedication
licensing.release_manifest: DIST-LICENSE-MANIFEST.json (generated from APK actual contents and release-specific GPL source archive)
licensing.music_license: LicenseRef-Suno-Commercial-Use (per-track official download and rights record required, not a general CC grant)

known_gaps: Gradle transitive dependency lockfiles and SHA-256 verification-metadata not yet generated; must be built from an actual resolved trusted Gradle run, independently reviewed before admission.

SMBJ 0.15.0 and transitive Bouncy Castle/SLF4J/Mbassador/ASN.1 dependencies were reviewed for source coordinates and permissive rights, but actual Android minSdk 26 packaging, combined DEX size, and S9 LAN handshake are pending full build/device verification.
Exact Android SDK commandline-tools revision, JDK 17 patch, GitHub runner OS image revision and upstream repository artifact mirrors not sealed.
Full legal review of packaged Valve handoff ZIP, Daydream controller derivative, commercial/shareware disposition, and GPL linking boundaries remains pending.
Emulator catalog source snapshots are optional and not active executable runtime dependencies; their licenses and commit digests must be vetted at install time.
Public repository source and published APKs are already distributions. Valve archive removed from current tree only; historical commits and releases remain available.
Automatic runtime downloads are not a workaround for noncommercial/third-party software licensing.
Owner has commercial-use entitlement to currently packaged Starry Cereal on Suno; song is not CC BY. Logo and Daydream derivative remain review-required.

Existing public phone-test builds may carry review-required assets, flagged in attached manifests; an unqualified/commercially open release is blocked until their rights are verified or the assets are replaced.
Artist profile lists 738 songs, but only Starry Cereal is packaged so far; other official downloads and individual rights checks not supplied. APK size may prevent all tracks in one build.
